# 00_inputs: raw material (do not edit)

- `fawzia-brief/`: the assignment as Fawzia gave it (screenshots, messages, files)
- `meetings/`: meeting notes, named `YYYY-MM-DD_topic.md`
- `references/`: Mobbin screenshots, app screenshots, inspiration. Name them `app-name_screen.png`

Synthesized findings go in `01_research/` and later folders, not here.
